patterns.note: The hero section features an asymmetrical layout with large, bold text overlapping a background image, complemented by a smaller, dynamically placed inset image.
Extremely bold, condensed sans-serif typography is used for all major headings and the prominent brand name, creating a strong, impactful visual hierarchy.
A high-contrast palette of black and white is accented by vibrant orange for CTAs and a striking orange-to-purple gradient used for background transitions and the footer.

A massive, full-screen brand name ('REDUCTIONS') reveals from the bottom as the user scrolls, replacing the main content and transitioning the background to a vibrant gradient, acting as a dramatic brand statement and footer.
The main navigation button transforms from a transparent background to a solid purple background with white text as the user scrolls down the page.
Course offerings are presented in a clean grid of image-based cards, each featuring a bold title and a subtle hover effect.
Testimonials are displayed in a multi-column grid of cards, each with a subtle background gradient and a clear profile image.

technique_notes: The hero section combines a large background image with overlaying, dynamically positioned text and a smaller, layered image to create a rich, editorial visual depth.

Scroll-triggered animations, likely powered by GSAP, are used to reveal the large brand name as a full-screen takeover, transitioning the background to a vibrant gradient and creating a memorable brand moment.
The main navigation button dynamically changes its background color and opacity upon scroll, indicating a sticky state and providing visual feedback.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, condensed sans-serif headings (~4-6x body) create a bold statement, complemented by smaller uppercase labels and legible body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding is applied to buttons and cards, while main content blocks maintain sharp corners.
design_tokens.spacing: Generally airy in the hero and between major sections, with a balanced density within content grids and card layouts.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the dramatic, full-screen reveal of the brand name 'REDUCTIONS' as a massive, animated element that takes over the page upon scroll, transforming into a vibrant gradient footer. This creates a powerful, memorable brand statement that is far from a generic footer.
